claims.claim: RAC jointly reconstructs activations from input and on-policy chain-of-thought traces during pruning.
claims.notes: ICLR proceedings URL cross-checked against arXiv:2509.12464 on 2026-11-25.

claims.claim: The reconstruction objective uses prompt and model-generated decode activations; conventional pruning can increase reasoning length.
Phase I collects model-generated calibration traces with SGLang.
Phase II builds calibration input and delegates pruning to llm-compressor.
Phase III serves checkpoints and reports accuracy, completion length and elapsed time.
